name: BS Man AI
short_description: Conversation Risk Intelligence API for AI agents.
description: BS Man AI analyzes English messages, offers, and dialogues for scam signals, manipulation tactics, unrealistic promises, pressure patterns, and unsafe next-step recommendations. The public POST /v1/analyze endpoint is x402-paid on Base mainnet, with discovery, health, and OpenAPI endpoints kept free.
disclaimers: Not a guarantee that something is true or false.
use_cases: Agent preflight check before recommending a payment or next step.
Scam and phishing risk review for user-submitted messages.
Manipulation and pressure-pattern detection in dialogue.
Offer risk review for jobs, rentals, investments, marketplace deals, and loans.
Safe reply generation that sets a verification boundary.
Agent action preflight checks for payment, wallet, credential, link, file, and external-tool actions.
